notes.description: Expected loan approval status for every record in loan_applications.json, produced by running the real loan-ops code path (intake validation -> four checks -> deterministic decision rules). Not hand-written.
notes.status_meaning: 'rejected_at_intake' is not one of the three decision outcomes; it means the record failed intake validation and was returned to the applicant without entering review (docs/PROCESS.md, docs/PROC.md step 2).
notes.reason: The rule(s) from docs/PROCESS.md that produced the status, including the executed check result(s) that justify it.
notes.ui_visibility: Not displayed in the UI. The web UI keeps every application in a waiting state until the agent runs; this file exists for offline verification and tests.
